value.rationale: The theorem gives the complete pointed counting-logic orbit invariant, exact class progression, sharp four-residue final obstruction, and an unexpected equality between iteration depth and root eccentricity for an infinite cubic graph family. The explicit frontier and endpoint effect are structurally reusable and not a textbook corollary of known automorphism-group or worst-case iteration results.
